source.author: Will MacKenzie
source.title: Representation of BEC units in Protected Areas of BC

measurement.numerator: Sum of each park/BGC intersection rounded to 0.001 km² in the source analysis
measurement.denominator: Area of the mapped BGC unit in the source CSV; not a terrestrial-land mask
measurement.missingValues: Blank source values remain null; no recorded intersection is not proof of no protection today.
measurement.displayPercent: Clamped to 0–100 only for bounded visual marks; source ratios and excess flags are retained.
measurement.parkNames: Source name groups; provincial names were truncated at the first hyphen before aggregation.
